title: Phase 2 Study of Novel Antibody-Drug Conjugate in HER2-Positive Stage III/IV Breast Cancer

inclusion_criteria.description: Histologically confirmed HER2-positive breast cancer (IHC 3+ or FISH positive).
Baseline LVEF >= 50% assessed by ECHO or MUGA scan within 60 days prior to enrollment.
Prior treatment with neoadjuvant or adjuvant systemic therapy.

exclusion_criteria.description: History of congestive heart failure or baseline LVEF < 50%.
